title: Salesforce rolls out new Slackbot AI agent as it battles Microsoft and Google in workplace AI
summary: Salesforce on Tuesday launched an entirely rebuilt version of Slackbot , the company's workplace assistant, transforming it from a simple notification tool into what executives describe as a fully powered AI agent capable of searching enterprise data, drafting documents, and taking action on behalf of employees.
